newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish bank shares jump on merger rumours.
newsitem.headline: Swedish bank shares jump on merger rumours.

text.p: Swedish banking shares jumped early Friday on a report in Swedish business newspaper Dagens Industri that the government is to sell a slice of Nordbanken to Investor AB.

Nordbanken shares jumped 14.5 crowns on opening to 230 crowns after rising nine crowns on Thursday amid merger rumours. The bank sector index rose 1.98 percent against a rise on the market overall of 0.62 percent.
Investor shares rose two crowns to 297 crowns.

Dagens Industri said the government had been in talks over the holiday period to sell 20-25 percent of its 58 percent hold of Nordbanken to Investor, the investment vehicle of the Wallenberg industrial empire.
The paper said this could pave the way for an eventual merger between Nordbanken and S-E-Banken of which the Wallenberg companies hold 15 percent of capital and 16 percent of votes.
S-E-Banken shares rose three to 71 crowns in early trade.
Investor has declined to comment on the report and a spokeswoman for Finance Minister Erik Asbrink said there were no negotiations over Nordbanken.
